data.name: Durrdana
data.gender_notes: Durrdana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic roots darr 'to be heavy' and dana 'to be honored'. It represents a woman of great esteem and dignity, who commands respect and admiration. In Islamic tradition, it is also associated with the virtue of having a noble character and being generous. The name Durrdana carries the meaning “Glory, Dignity, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Durrdana usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, dignity, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes honor and respect in the sight of Allah and the community.
data.etymology: Durrdana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory, Dignity, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durrdana total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
